description: This file contains unit tests for the DittoAckRequestsFilter class within the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package. It tests various scenarios of filtering acknowledgement requests based on specific criteria, such as immutability, presence of certain acknowledgment labels, and handling of empty or non-matching values.

classes.name: DittoAckRequestsFilterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DittoAckRequestsFilter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DittoAckRequestsFilter instances are immutable.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Verifies filtering logic when the header does not match any specific acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: filterValueWithTwinPersistedOnlyAckRequest
methods.description: Checks that only TWIN_PERSISTED acknowledgment requests are filtered out, resulting in null.

methods.name: filterEmptyStringValue
methods.description: Ensures an empty string value results in null.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutDittoInternalRequests
methods.description: Verifies that non-Ditto acknowledgment requests are preserved.

methods.name: filterValueWithDittoInternalRequests
methods.description: Tests removal of internal acknowledgement labels from the list of requests.

methods.name: filterValueWithEmptyAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Checks filtering behavior when acknowledgment values contain empty labels.
